messages:
June: Quick clarifying Q for the offer: contractor starts 11/10 and might accrue a couple sick days before offboarding. Can we convert unused sick into a floating holiday or do a one-time cash payout? Need exact wording for the offer letter.

Olivia (People Ops): Generally sick leave is treated separately. No automatic conversion to PTO or cash for either contractors or employees unless an exception is approved.

Sam (Eng): Contractors vs W-2 anything different we should call out?

Olivia (People Ops): Yes. For W-2s we follow state law (some states prohibit payout). For contractors, it's a contract matter. We can sometimes add a one-off amendment to the SOW to cover it, but requires manager + People Ops + Legal sign-off.

Mike (Manager): Budget is fine to cover small payout if needed. What's required operationally?

Lina (Payroll): From payroll side: we can process a discretionary payment or add a floating day, but timing is strict. Needs written approval (email thread ok) and a payroll flag before the invoice/payroll cutoff. For November payroll cutoff: 11/28.

June: Good to know. I'll avoid promising auto-conversion. I'll add: "unused sick may be considered for a one-time exception subject to People Ops & Finance approval; not guaranteed." Is that ok?

Olivia (People Ops): That phrasing works. Also include a note: "if contractor, subject to contract amendment and Legal review."

June: Another thing 12/18 is our launch and an IC asked to take 12/15-12/17 (3 days) right before launch. Can we grant a blackout exception?

Mike (Manager): We usually block PTO in the two weeks before a launch unless coverage is arranged. If IC can be on-call for launch day and we have a coverage plan, we may approve. Need a short coverage note in the exception request.

Sam (Eng): Practically, coverage plan should include who will merge/fix, who will monitor, and confirmation the IC can join the on-call rotation.

Olivia (People Ops): Process: manager files exception ticket in people-ops, attach coverage plan + confirmation of backup. People Ops will review for fairness across team. If approved, we can grant a compensatory floating day after the launch.

Lina (Payroll): Implementation: People Ops submits grant to Payroll with employee ID and date; payroll adds one discretionary floating day within 2 pay cycles. It's manual.

June: Perfect. I'll draft offer and the exception template.

people-ops-bot: New exception ticket created: #HR-2026-349. Please attach manager approval and coverage plan. Expected triage: 2 business days.

Olivia (People Ops): Thanks all. June 12When you have manager sign-off, drop it in the ticket and ping me. If contractor payout is requested, I'll loop Legal and Finance. :white_check_mark:"
